posts.text: ADHD is having the best real estate business idea at midnight but forgetting it by morning
ADHD made me think I was lazy. Healing taught me I was just tired of pretending.
ADHD hack: don’t wait for motivation. Create momentum.
Time doesn’t exist. Only “hyperfocus” and “what day is it again?”
ADHD doesn’t mean unmotivated — it means motivated by meaning. Be honest — this one’s you too, right?
My ADHD brain paints in ideas, not lines. Relatable?
